en.name: Humanities and Digital Technologies Platform
en.description: The Humanities and Digital Technologies Platform is a collaborative community at HKUST bringing together faculty, library, and students to explore digital humanities skills and develop innovative digital projects.

hero.headline: Explore the potential within humanities and digital innovation
hero.subtitle: Uniting digital technology and humanities through creativity — pioneering digital methods, collaborative research, and innovative projects that shape the future of scholarship, culture, and society.

about.heading: About us
paragraphs: The Humanities and Digital Technologies Platform is a collaborative community aimed at bringing together faculty, library, and students to explore digital humanities skills and develop innovative digital projects. It bridges the gap between science and the humanities through digital methods and practices.

Launched in spring 2022 by the Division of Humanities and the HKUST Library, the platform supports and promotes digital humanities work across the university — coordinating training for students and research assistants, publishing and disseminating digital projects produced by HKUST students and faculty, and collaborating with regional partners through the Hong Kong Digital Humanities consortium series of lectures and workshops.

zh.description: 人文及數碼科技研究平台是香港科技大學的協作社群,匯聚教師、圖書館與學生,共同探索數碼人文技能,並開發創新的數碼項目,以數碼方法與實踐連結科學與人文。

hero.eyebrow: 人文及數碼科技研究平台
hero.headline: 探索人文與數碼創新的無限可能
hero.subtitle: 以創意連結數碼科技與人文 — 引領數碼方法、協作研究與創新項目,塑造學術、文化與社會的未來。

about.heading: 關於我們
paragraphs: 人文及數碼科技研究平台是一個協作社群,旨在匯聚教師、圖書館與學生,探索數碼人文技能並開發創新的數碼項目,以數碼方法與實踐填補科學與人文之間的鴻溝。
平台於2022年春季由人文學部與香港科技大學圖書館共同創立,支援並推廣校內的數碼人文工作 — 包括為學生及研究助理統籌培訓、出版及傳播科大師生製作的數碼人文項目,以及透過香港數碼人文聯盟的講座與工作坊系列與區內夥伴合作。
